cases.question: ¿Cuántos asientos registrados hubo por diario en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.book, COUNT(*) AS total FROM journal_entry je WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY je.book ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.book AS diario, COUNT(*) AS total_asientos FROM public.journal_entry AS je WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.book LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en octubre de 2026? Indica el código, la fecha, el total al debe y el total al haber de cada asiento.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.code, je.entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS codigo, je.entry_date AS fecha, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0)) > 0.01 LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el saldo neto del elemento contable 3 en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND aa.code LIKE '3%' AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo_neto FROM public.journal_entry_detail AS jed JOIN public.journal_entry AS je ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (aa.id = 3 AND je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto sumaron el debe y el haber por tipo de cuenta en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT aa.type, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY aa.type ORDER BY aa.type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT aa.type AS tipo, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry_detail AS jed JOIN public.journal_entry AS je ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY aa.type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables con estado abierto estuvieron vigentes en algún momento de octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-11-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS periodos_abiertos FROM public.accounting_period AS ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND ap.end_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50
